from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,sys
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"control/codex_supervisor"))
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"control/jobs"))
import full_a2z_governed_v4 as a2z
import model_quality_gate as q

model_task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2"
src=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees/DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-RETRY-20261006-E106/knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"
dst=root/"knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"
if not src.exists():
    print("E115=SOURCE_BUNDLE_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(38)
if dst.exists(): shutil.rmtree(dst)
shutil.copytree(src,dst)
overlay=json.loads((dst/"overlay.json").read_text())

review=a2z.import_review(dst,overlay,"POSTBUILD",model_task)
decision=str(review.get("decision","")).upper()
expected=q.expected_review_ref(overlay,"POSTBUILD")
path=dst/expected
print("E115_IMPORT decision="+decision+" source="+str(review.get("source_task_id"))+" ref_exists="+str(path.exists()),flush=True)
if review.get("source_task_id")!=model_task:
    print("E115=SOURCE_TASK_MISMATCH",flush=True); raise SystemExit(41)
if decision=="APPROVE":
    loaded,ref=q.load_review(dst,overlay,"POSTBUILD")
    if loaded is None:
        print("E115=APPROVE_BUT_EXPECTED_REF_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(31)
    if ref!=expected:
        print("E115=APPROVE_REF_MISMATCH",flush=True); raise SystemExit(33)
    print("E115=EXACT_R3P2_APPROVE",flush=True); raise SystemExit(0)
if decision=="REVISE":
    print("E115=EXACT_R3P2_REVISE",flush=True); raise SystemExit(20)
if decision=="REJECT":
    print("E115=EXACT_R3P2_REJECT",flush=True); raise SystemExit(21)
print("E115=UNEXPECTED_DECISION_"+decision,flush=True); raise SystemExit(22)
